english.title: Attempt to operate equipment beneath clothing of another without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), attempted to operate equipment **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..), beneath the clothing of another person with the intention of enabling you or a third person to observe the genitals, buttocks, or underwear covering the genitals or buttocks, of the other person in circumstances where they would not otherwise be visible, for the purpose of

(A)_[obtaining sexual gratification,]_
(B)_[humiliating, alarming or distressing that person,]_

doing so without consent and without reasonably believing that the person consented
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 67A(1) and (4) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section 1 of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Notes
(i) It makes no difference whether the victim of the offence is exposed or covered with underwear for the purpose of this offence.
(ii) As per sections 67A(3)(a) if the offence is being committed for sexual gratification, the gratification can be for the person recording the offence or for other persons.
(ii) As per section 68(1A), for the purpose of this offence, operating equipment includes enabling or securing activation by another person without that person's knowledge.
(iii) Victims of this offence are entitled to anonymity under section 2 of the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 1992.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 67A(4)(a) and (5) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
